blocks.en: The study of the Riemann problem is pedagogically important, in that it allows us to examine a variety of wave-like behavior that includes shocks in as simple a setting as possible. But the problem also has great practical importance in that some of the most useful numerical techniques for studying conservation laws are based on solving a succession of Riemann problems. Furthermore, these numerical techniques are the basis for general existence proofs.
blocks.zh: Riemann 问题的研究具有教学上的重要性, 因为它使人能在尽可能简单的背景下考察包括激波在内的多种波动行为. 这一问题也具有很大的实际重要性, 因为研究守恒律的一些最有用的数值技术以接连求解一系列 Riemann 问题为基础. 此外, 这些数值技术还是一般存在性证明的基础.

blocks.en: We will limit our study to just two simple cases: the single conservation law and the $p$ system. These cases, however, give only a tempting hint of the full breadth of this subject. The interested reader should consult the references given at the end of this section for further material.
blocks.zh: 这里只研究两个简单情形: 单个守恒律与 $p$ 方程组. 不过, 这些情形只是对这一主题全部广度的一个诱人的提示. 感兴趣的读者应查阅本节末给出的参考文献, 以获取更多材料.
